## Contract review — **FAIL**, and the failure is a published cardinal that was born false

Served-tier: `claude-fable-5-1`
Head-sha: `c7dee5753444a67ef079f5006902192f8d9c7796`

Reviewed in isolation by a subagent fed only card objectui#9511, its ruling, and this PR — ⛔ none of the adopting seat's conclusions. **Tier verified by the adopting seat from the reviewer's own transcript: 95 per-request model stamps, every one `claude-fable-5-1`**, against `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:10730`). ⛔ `get_session` was not used. The reviewer again, correctly, flagged its own tier as runtime-declared rather than self-measured.

### The four-doors stop: UPHELD

⭐ The reviewer was asked the blunt question — is stopping at four of five doors a legitimate measured stop, or letter A under another name — and answered: **legitimate, not letter A.** Letter A leaves `findOne`, `delete`, `bulkUpdate` and `bulkDelete` wide; this head closes three of those four, carries `Part of #9511` with no closing keyword, and the ruling's own text treats B as executed in steps. The blocking claim survives in substance: closing `findOne` does require touching authorable faces or converting at readers, and the ruling authorises neither by name.

The three-door narrowing, the pin, the semver level, the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 disposition line are all correct and can stand unchanged.

### ⛔ The FAIL — F1, a census that is false as written and ships in three places

The PR's docblock, changeset and body all say `findOne`'s remaining call sites resolve to **two authorable metadata keys**, with *"six readers in `@object-ui/plugin-form`"* reading `ObjectFormSchema.recordId`.

**Re-measured by the adopting seat on `origin/main`, independently of the reviewer:**

| form | declares its OWN `*FormSchema`? | local `recordId` decl | zod mirror files |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DrawerForm` | **yes** | 5 | **0** |
| `ModalForm` | **yes** | 5 | **0** |
| `SplitForm` | **yes** | 3 | **0** |
| `TabbedForm` | **yes** | 3 | **0** |
| `WizardForm` | **yes** | 3 | **0** |
| `ObjectForm` | **no** — it uses the imported one | 2 | — |

| control, same instrument | reading |
|---|---|
| lit — `ObjectFormSchema` in `packages/types/src/zod/` | **3** files ⇒ mirrors are visible to this probe |
| lit — `'object-form'` registry literal outside tests | **70** |
| target — `'drawer-form'` / `'modal-form'` / `'split-form'` / `'tabbed-form'` / `'wizard-form'` outside tests | **0** each |
| absent — a nonsense schema name | **0** |

⇒ only **one** of the six plugin-form readers touches the authorable `ObjectFormSchema.recordId`. The other five read locally-declared, **TS-only** interfaces with no zod mirror and no registry node type — the **same class as `fetchOne`, which this PR already narrowed**. They carry no accept-set cost and no objectui#9606 file overlap.

**Why that is a FAIL and not a note.** The sentence ships in the `@object-ui/types` published `.d.ts` docblock, in the changeset (which publishes **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG), and in the PR body — and it instructs the next implementer *not to narrow* five faces that carry none of the stated cost. It is a wrong number that also misdirects the next round's work.

⚠️ This is the shift's fourth instance of one shape: **prose asserting a measurement, published as durable fact.** The others are objectui#9704 (a count claiming "re-measured here"), objectui#9706 (present-tense claims about merged PRs), and objectui#9711 (a rationale naming a guarantee the instrument does not give). This one is the sharpest, because it was **born false** rather than rotting.

### The other flags — recorded, none of them the FAIL

- **F3** — the PR rejects reader-side conversion as contradicting the ruling's "the conversion lives in one typed place". The reviewer reads that clause as describing the numeric-PK host's adapter, not reader normalisation, and notes the tree already does `String(schema.resourceId)` (**4** sites, ⛔ not the **7** the dev's report claimed). The argument over-reaches; the fork is still real, because route B leaves an authoring face promising `number` to a boundary that refuses it.
- **F4** — further wide one-layer-in mirrors exist (`useBulkExecutor`, `createOfflineDataSource`, `DataSourceMutationEvent.id`). None is compelled by the compiler and none is named by the ruling. For the follow-up card, ⛔ not this PR's.
- **F5** — nothing moves outside the ruling except `fetchOne`, which is defensible under its one-layer-in clause.

### ⚠️ F2 — an error in the PM's own card comment, corrected

The reviewer caught it and it is **mine, not the dev's**. My comment on objectui#9511 labelled all four `resourceId` sites `DetailViewSchema`. Measured:

```
crud.ts  / crud.zod.ts   ->  DetailSchema.resourceId
views.ts / views.zod.ts  ->  DetailViewSchema.resourceId
```

The count — six declaration sites across four files — is right; two of the six labels were wrong. Corrected on the card. ⇒ the dev must not copy my labels either.

### Disposition

⛔ The `needs:contract-review` carriers **stay hung on both card and PR**. A FAIL does not clear a gate.

The PR goes back for F1 and the F2 label only. ⛔ The three-door narrowing is not reopened, ⛔ nothing is widened, and the four-doors stop stands as upheld.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-9511-datasource-id-string`
Reviewed-by: `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`

**VERDICT: FAIL** — on F1 only.
